summary: Guided rollback script and shadow-traffic rehydrate for tenant quant-prefetch eviction causing streaming disconnects
summary_long: Customer reports sudden increase in streaming disconnects and partial responses after enabling a tenant-scoped custom int8 quantization profile plus aggressive KV prefetch. They ask for a safe, repeatable rollback script and an option to shadow traffic to the previous profile while preserving telemetry for post-incident analysis.
description:
Issue summary: After applying a tenant-scoped custom int8 quant profile and enabling high KV prefetch for context prefix caching, NovatoHealth observed intermittent streaming disconnects (clients receive partial payloads) and a spike in 5xx errors for chat streaming endpoints. Impact: customer production chat features degraded, multiple customer SLAs threatened; some long-running sessions terminated mid-response. They want a tested rollback procedure that can be executed without re-deploying model artifacts, plus a shadow-traffic path to compare behavior before fully switching back.

Why unique: tenant used a combination of aggressive prefetch (prefetch_window=2048) with a custom quant schedule that increases activations-per-layer; at scale this appears to cause memory-eviction pressure in the serving runtime which then triggers transient stream termination while trying to recover. Customer requests a script they can run (or that Support can run) with clear checks and telemetry snapshot/restore steps.
impact: Multiple production customers of NovatoHealth experiencing partial responses and client disconnects on chat-stream endpoints. Estimated affected requests: ~2.3k/monthly for this tenant; immediate impact to live product demos and two enterprise customers. Latency SLO violations observed for 95p and 99p.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In tenant config, set quant_profile to custom-int8-v3 and prefetch_window=2048 for model open-llama-65b-quant-custom-int8
2) Send repeated streaming chat requests with long context (system prompt + 6 user turns, ~3k tokens total) at concurrency 25
3) Observe streaming connections that terminate mid-response or return 5xx with 'eviction-failure' in runtime logs
4) Revert to platform default quant_profile and prefetch_window=512 to confirm reduction in disconnects
recent_logs: [2026-03-12T13:04:12Z] serving-runtime: eviction-triggered; freed 512MB KV blocks for tenant=novato-prod-01; [2026-03-12T13:04:13Z] stream-manager: stream closed before end-of-stream, code=EVICT_PARTIAL; [2026-03-12T13:05:01Z] api-gateway: 502 upstream error to runtime (tenant=novato-prod-01). Full traces attached to internal log link: https://logs.redwood.internal/tenants/novato/2026-03-12/evictions
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: combined memory amplification from custom quant schedule + prefetch window caused transient KV cache eviction that disrupted streaming handshake and buffer flush.

Telemetry: memory pressure spikes correlate with 5xx bursts around 13:03-13:10 UTC; per-GPU utilization was within expected range, but allocator fragmentation high on affected nodes (see GPU-telemetry dashboard).
Canary check: routing 5% of traffic to fallback (non-quantized) model immediately reduced 5xx events for that cohort — suggests problem is config-specific, not model artifact corruption.
Related alerts: Incident INC-2026-0312-01 created to capture cluster-level eviction events.
diagnostic_checks_run: config-audit: confirmed tenant-scoped profile enabled at 2026-03-12T11:58:02Z
telemetry-snapshot: collected runtime memory/kv metrics and in-flight stream counts (s3://redwood-support-snapshots/novato/2026-03-12/)
replay-test: synthetic load against model with identical config reproduced partial stream behavior in staging nodes
customer_message: NovatoHealth CSM reports this rollout was intentional to reduce unit cost; they urgently need a safe way to step back to stable behavior while retaining the ability to re-run the experiment later. They prefer Support-provided script due to limited infra team bandwidth.
workaround_actions: We recommended immediate traffic-split to fallback profile (console -> routing overrides) and lowering prefetch_window to 512 as a temporary measure. Customer accepts performing the split but requested a runnable script to automate the revert and capture a final telemetry snapshot for postmortem.
proposed_rollback_script_steps: 1) Run preflight 'snapshot-collect' (collect config + runtime counters + active-stream PIDs) and upload to support S3 path
2) Apply tenant config patch: set quant_profile=platform-default-int8 and prefetch_window=512 via tenant-config API
3) Immediately split traffic: routing override 90% -> patched config, 10% -> previous config for monitoring (duration 30m)
4) Monitor evictions and stream-close metrics for 30 minutes; if 95p latency and 5xx count fall below thresholds, promote 100% traffic to patched config
5) Save post-rollback telemetry snapshot and annotate with linked incident ID
support_actions_taken: Captured telemetry snapshot, reproduced issue in isolated staging, drafted the rollback steps and a small helper script to perform the tenant-config patch + traffic-split. Created this ticket to coordinate execution with customer 'change window'.

resolution_plan: Schedule a 30-minute change window with NovatoHealth on 2026-03-13 13:00 UTC. Support will run the rollback script, perform the 90/10 traffic split for 30 minutes, and monitor telemetry. If stable, we will promote to 100% and archive snapshots. Post-action: prepare short postmortem and recommendations for future experiments (prefetch upper bound guidance and quant schedule gating).
resolution_notes: Performed rollback 2026-03-13 13:05 UTC: applied platform-default-int8 and prefetch_window=512, traffic split 90/10 for 30m. 5xx rate dropped from 4.6% -> 0.2% and stream-close EVICT_PARTIAL events reduced to baseline. Customer confirmed production chat flows healthy. Snapshots stored at s3://redwood-support-snapshots/novato/2026-03-13/post-rollback
follow_up_items: 1) Create tenant-specific guardrails: console should warn if prefetch_window > 1024 when custom quant_profile is enabled
2) Add an automated canary test to catch stream partials after config changes
3) Schedule a runbook review meeting with NovatoHealth on 2026-03-20
